hits.title: Handel's Messiah
hits.excerpt:
What do we believe in when things are uncertain?

Sound the trumpets! H+H Conductor Laureate Harry Christophers returns to lead Boston’s must-see Messiah. For the 173rd consecutive year, the H+H Orchestra, Chorus, and luminous soloists fill Symphony Hall with music that moves through uncertainty, reflection, and radiant joy. Handel’s masterpiece reminds us that when the future is unclear, we can find strength in what endures. Gather friends and family and experience a holiday tradition “as essential as trimming the tree” (The Boston Globe).

Music
Handel: Messiah

Performed by
Harry Christophers, conductor
Hilary Cronin, soprano
Christopher Lowrey, countertenor
Robert Murray, tenor
Roderick Williams, bass-baritone
H+H Orchestra and Chorus

Concert runs 2 hours and 50 minutes including intermission.

hits.title: TLI Jazz: Ted Rosenthal Quartet featuring Terell Stafford—The Good Old Days
hits.excerpt:
Rosenthal and his trio will be joined by trumpeter Terell Stafford in a program featuring music from Rosenthal's most recent CD release, The Good Old Days. The music will include standards and originals that cover earlier styles of jazz: swing, early bop, and ragtime. 

"Virtuosic and light-stepping, Rosenthal and his bandmates make classic, classy music with deep roots in the jazz tradition."  —AllAboutJazz 

"These fresh and interesting interpretations of classic formative jazz styles make very enjoyable listening."  —Jazz Journal 

During November and the first half of December, TLI concerts will serve as a drop-off location for this year’s U. S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program in coordination with the Massachusetts State Police. Guests are asked to please bring a new, unwrapped, non-violent toy to drop in the collection boxes located in the Linde Center lobby.

hits.title: TLI Focal Point: Introduction to Smartphone Photography
hits.excerpt: This two-hour workshop will allow participants to master the basic capabilities of their smartphone or tablet camera. The class covers all in-device functions and a short but valuable segment on in-device editing of images. Instructor: Thad Kubis (Rain location: Tanglewood Provisions)
